briefings.title: CVE-2026-102490: Zammad GmbH Zammad actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-102489: Zammad GmbH Zammad actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-102322 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.6)
briefings.excerpt: Incorrect Authorization in SiteIsolation in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.39 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

briefings.title: CVE-2026-106197 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.6)
briefings.excerpt: Use after free in Browser in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.39 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)

briefings.title: CVE-2026-106211 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.6)
briefings.excerpt: Use after free in TabStrip in Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.39 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)
